title: Tag text

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

tag.description: The game's gameplay tag, as it appears in the other files (item tags, weapon archetypes, calibers, damage types, roles, slots).

text.description: The text the game shows for the tag.

source.description: The game's table the text comes from, for example `Archetypes`, `Calibers` or `Roles`.

items.description: One tag with its display text.

tags.description: Tags with text, sorted by tag then source. A tag can appear under more than one source with different text.

description: Display text for the game's gameplay tags, to turn tags such as `Item.Archetype.AR` into words. Only tags with text are listed.
